commit_message: Focus ADR0147 detached window for visual capture
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR0147 detached AI Studio
pr_body:
## Summary

- implement ADR0147 Tier 1 as a detachable native eframe viewport while retaining one project-scoped Agent Host
- preserve session/run/permission/workspace/resource-arbitration state across detach, close, reopen, and reattach
- capture the actual detached Windows child window for visual validation and focus that child during validation so desktop pixels correspond to the detached viewport
- mark ADR0147 Accepted
